theorem.state_boundary: LET X CONTAIN THE COMPLETE LOAD-BEARING SOURCE OUTCOME STATE INCLUDING CONTEXT HISTORY ROUTING INPUTS AUTHORITY/RESOURCE STATE AND ANY RANDOMNESS CONTROL NEEDED TO MAKE THE TRANSFORM CONDITIONALLY WELL DEFINED.
theorem.target_boundary: LET Y CONTAIN THE COMPLETE LOAD-BEARING TARGET OUTCOME STATE.
theorem.transform: ANY DEPLOYED DETERMINISTIC OR RANDOMIZED TRANSFORM FROM X TO Y DEFINES A STOCHASTIC KERNEL K(dy|x)=P(Y in dy | X=x). DETERMINISTIC TRANSFORMS ARE THE 0/1 SPECIAL CASE.
theorem.composition: THE COMPOSITION OF K1 FROM X TO Y AND K2 FROM Y TO Z IS K(z|x)=SUM_y K1(y|x)K2(z|y) IN THE DISCRETE OBSERVABLE CASE; IT IS AGAIN A STOCHASTIC KERNEL.
theorem.pullback: FOR ANY TARGET EVALUATOR g, Kg(x)=E[g(Y)|X=x]. V6 ALREADY PROVES SOURCE DOMINANCE TRANSFERS WHEN Kg IS IN THE CERTIFIED SOURCE EVALUATOR SET AND HARD CONSTRAINTS HAVE PREIMAGES/INVARIANT WITNESSES.
theorem.conclusion: A SEPARATE ENUMERATION OF SEMANTIC TRANSFORM KINDS SUCH AS selection/artifact/state_transition/candidate_generation IS NOT LOAD-BEARING FOR C GENERATOR COMPLETENESS. WHAT IS LOAD-BEARING IS COMPLETE STATE BINDING FOR EACH ACTUAL CREDITED TRANSFORM INSTANCE/CLASS AND ITS EVALUATOR PULLBACK/HARD-CONSTRAINT PREIMAGE CERTIFICATES.

why_this_is_not_vacuous: IF A LOAD-BEARING HISTORY CONTEXT ROUTER OR HIDDEN STATE VARIABLE IS OMITTED FROM X, THE REPRESENTATION CERTIFICATE FAILS CLOSED.
THE THEOREM DOES NOT ASSERT THE PULLBACK IS ALREADY CERTIFIED.
THE THEOREM DOES NOT ASSERT EVERY POSSIBLE TRANSFORM IS USED OR OWNED BY BRAIN.
THE THEOREM ONLY DELETES THE NEED TO PROVE COMPLETENESS OF AN ARBITRARY HUMAN-NAMED TRANSFORM TAXONOMY.

replace_with: CONTENT_ADDRESS_THE_ACTUAL TRANSFORM IMPLEMENTATION OR STOCHASTIC LAW BOUNDARY
FOR_EACH_LOAD_BEARING TARGET EVALUATOR BIND ITS KERNEL PULLBACK TO A CERTIFIED SOURCE EVALUATOR OR FAIL CLOSED
FOR_EACH TARGET HARD CONSTRAINT BIND A SOURCE PREIMAGE OR FAIL-CLOSED INVARIANT WITNESS
C_repair_if_verified.composition: NO ARBITRARY FINITE SEQUENCE ENUMERATION AFTER LOCAL CERTIFICATES; KERNEL COMPOSITION PLUS EXISTING TRANSFORM-CLOSURE THEOREM CARRIES THEM.

falsifiers: A LOAD-BEARING DEPLOYED TRANSFORM CANNOT BE REPRESENTED AS A CONDITIONAL LAW GIVEN THE DECLARED COMPLETE SOURCE STATE.
A LOAD-BEARING EXTERNAL CONTROL CHANGES THE TRANSFORM BUT IS OMITTED FROM THE SOURCE STATE.
A TARGET EVALUATOR HAS NO SOUND PULLBACK INTO THE CERTIFIED SOURCE EVALUATOR SEMANTICS.
A TARGET HARD CONSTRAINT HAS NO SOURCE PREIMAGE OR INVARIANT PRESERVATION WITNESS.
AN INTERACTIVE COMPOSITION USES STATE NOT REPRESENTED IN THE INTERMEDIATE OUTCOME SPACE.
hard_nonclaims: NO CLAIM CURRENT TRANSFORM STATE BOUNDARIES ARE COMPLETE.
NO CLAIM CURRENT PULLBACK CERTIFICATES EXIST FOR ALL CREDITED TRANSFORMS.
NO TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OR OWNERSHIP CREDIT.
